summary: The filing is a Form 8-K by Banc of America Merrill Lynch Commercial Mortgage Inc., as depositor, reporting the issuance of commercial mortgage pass-through certificates under a pooling and servicing agreement. Multiple classes of publicly and privately offered certificates were sold to underwriters and initial purchasers. This is a routine structured finance issuance and not a special situation; no acquisition, divestiture, activist, review, tender, going-private, capital return, spin-off, restructuring, or management change is involved. The filing merely satisfies SEC disclosure obligations for a new asset-backed securities offering.
